name: Loredana Crisan
title: Chief Design Officer
research_notes: CDO at Figma since Sep 2025. Came from Meta/Instagram (VP Head of Messenger and Instagram DMs, GenAI Products). C-Level design hire signals serious design ops investment. Based in San Francisco.

name: Noah Levin
title: VP of Product Design
research_notes: VP of Product Design at Figma (updated from Head). Oversees product design, UX writing, and UX research. Grew team from 3 to 80+. Now reports up to new CDO Loredana Crisan. Still the day-to-day design org leader.

name: Randy Hunt
title: Head of Design
research_notes: Head of Design at Notion since April 2024. Still current as of mid-2026 — spoke at UXDX USA in May 2026. Focused on skill-based design teams and AI integration. Team of 100M+ user product. Formerly VP Design at Etsy, Head of Design at Artsy and Grab. Based in NYC.

name: Christina (CJ) Jones
title: Head of Design, Generative AI
research_notes: Head of Design for GenAI at Canva — the highest-leverage design role given Canva's AI push. Andrew Green (previous contact) departed Canva in 2026. Canva now has a decentralized multi-head structure. CJ is the best fit given Ryan's AI + design ops angle. Previously at Grab, Allen Institute for AI. Based in Australia.

name: Jonnie Farrell
title: Head of Design, Canva for Business
research_notes: Head of Design for Canva for Business since Jan 2026. Leads design org of 35+ designers across product, research, and content. Enterprise/B2B focus — relevant for design ops at scale. Based in Sydney.

name: Ari Liusaari
title: VP, Head of Design
research_notes: VP, Head of Design at Miro since Jan 2026 — brand new in role, actively shaping the org. Previously VP Design & Brand at Personio, Senior Director at Spotify, Creative Director at frog Design. Award-winning designer based in New York. Very high value to reach as he's building the design org from scratch.

name: Tjard Reimann
title: Head of Design, Growth
research_notes: Still at Miro as Head of Design, Growth. PLG expert, 10+ years product design leadership. Now reports to Ari Liusaari (new VP). Secondary contact — Ari is the primary.

name: Kevin Wong
title: VP of Product Design
research_notes: VP of Product Design at Webflow. Leading the evolution from website builder to multi-product AI-native platform — AI-augmented design ops is directly in scope. Previously at Airbnb, Meta. Based in Seattle.

name: Jorn van Dijk
title: CPO & Co-founder
research_notes: CPO and Co-founder of Framer. No dedicated VP/Head of Design role exists — design vision lives with Jorn and Benjamin den Boer (Head of Product). Framer is design-first by nature; Jorn is the decision-maker for any design leadership hire. Amsterdam-based.

name: Conor Muirhead
title: Head of Product Design
research_notes: Head of Product Design at Linear since June 2025 — relatively new in role. Reports to CEO Karri Saarinen. Previously Head of Design at Rewatch, Lead Designer at 37signals (HEY, Basecamp). Linear grew from ~74 to 130 people in the past year. Conor is a craftsman-first designer — angle on AI-augmented workflows would resonate.

name: Karri Saarinen
title: CEO & Co-founder
research_notes: CEO of Linear with strong design background (ex-Airbnb). Design and product report directly to Karri. Secondary contact — Conor Muirhead is the primary design leadership contact now. Karri still relevant if the goal is to create a new design ops role that doesn't exist.

name: Vlad Zely
title: Head of Product Design
research_notes: Head of Product Design at Pitch as of 2026 (confirmed via Pitch's own website). Pitch is a ~75-person Berlin-based company (remote-first). Design team is small (~3 in design dept per LinkedIn). Lower priority — smaller org, less design ops need.

name: Jaime Mariko McFarland
title: VP, Head of Design
research_notes: VP, Head of Design at Airtable since May 2023. Reports directly to CEO. Leads Product Design, Research, Brand, and Creative. Active speaker on AI transformation — most recently at CPO Summit in Dec 2026 on Airtable's AI-native pivot. Formerly at Slack, Lyra Health. VERY strong alignment with Ryan's positioning. Based in San Francisco.

name: Collin Whitehead
title: VP of Design
research_notes: VP of Design at the new Superhuman (rebranded Grammarly) since Oct 2025. NOTE: The original Superhuman email app (~20 designers) was acquired by Grammarly, which then acquired Coda and rebranded the whole company as 'Superhuman' — now a 920-person productivity platform. Jonas Downey is Head of Design for Superhuman Mail specifically. Collin leads the full design org across all products. Much larger org than original target — design ops need is higher now.

name: Jonas Downey
title: Head of Design, Superhuman Mail
research_notes: Head of Design for Superhuman Mail (the email product) since Jan 2026. Previously at Figma (launched Dev Mode, Figma Sites), Twitter, 37signals. Reports up to Collin Whitehead. Highly respected design craftsman. Lower priority than Collin for an ops-level role.
